parameter-group.name: voice
parameter-group.label: Voice Control
parameter-group.description: Define the phrases you can use to interact with the speaker (leave empty to disable).

parameter-group.name: media-providers
parameter-group.label: Media Providers
parameter-group.description: Configure required credentials for the supported media providers.

parameter.name: stopDropInPhrase
parameter.label: Stop Drop In Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase to stop drop-in on the current speaker.

parameter.name: commandSentMessage
parameter.label: Command send message
parameter.description: Phrase to say on the speaker on command success.

parameter.name: decreaseMediaVolumePhrase
parameter.label: Decrease Media Volume Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase template to decrease the media volume by the configured step.

parameter.name: increaseMediaVolumePhrase
parameter.label: Increase Media Volume Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase template to increase the media volume by the configured step.

parameter.name: mediaVolumeStep
parameter.label: Media Volume Step
parameter.description: Volume step used by the increase/decrease media volume phrases.

parameter.name: fastForwardMediaProgressPhrase
parameter.label: Fast-Forward Media Progress Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase template to fast-forward the media progress.

parameter.name: rewindMediaProgressPhrase
parameter.label: Rewind Media Progress Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase template to rewind the media progress.

parameter.name: nextMediaPhrase
parameter.label: Next Media Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase template to go to the next media item.

parameter.name: previousMediaPhrase
parameter.label: Previous Media Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase template to go to the previous media item.

parameter.name: listenOnWebPhrase
parameter.label: Listen on Web Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase to listen on web audio player (Example: 'tune $*').

parameter.name: watchOnWebPhrase
parameter.label: Watch on Web Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase to watch on web audio player (Example: 'watch channel $*').

parameter.name: continueMediaOnPhrase
parameter.label: Continue Media On Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase to continue media on another speaker (Example: 'continue on $*').

parameter.name: claimMediaPhrase
parameter.label: Claim Media Phrase
parameter.description: Phrase to continue media into the current speaker (Example: 'continue here').
